description: Wyniki pomiarów zmienności masy jabłek na sitach dwupoziomowych suszarki w czasie suszenia dla temp. powietrza na wlocie do komory 40stC, przy przepływie 300 m3/h, 600m3/h oraz 900m3/h is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fabryka Lodów Jan Januszewski. Badania kinetyki procesu suszenia jabłek w suszarce 2–poziomowej z poziomym przepływem powietrza miały określić jak długo trwa proces suszenia przy stałej temperaturze (40oC) i objętościowym natężeniu strumienia powietrza na wlocie do komory suszarni. Coverage: Fabryka Lodów Jan Januszewski. The publisher named on the listing is Fabryka Lodów Jan Januszewski. Its keywords include Suszenie jabłek. The listing shows 3 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
